title: A HIT SENTRY BARELY MOVES
why: His Q5: enemy feel. Every body was pushed 5 px by a hit. The Sentry is the heaviest common machine (radius 22), so it now barely rocks, 3 px at the full 0.16 s flash, which sets it apart from the raider (6.5 px) and the Crawler (8 px).
now: A Sentry you hit now barely moves.

edits.replacement: var HIT_JOLT={crawler:8,raider:6.5,sentry:3};   // v28.xx (cw-joltsentry), his Q5 enemy feel: the Sentry (radius 22, the heaviest common machine) 5 to 3 px at the full 0.16 s flash, so it reads as plate that holds its ground
